item.title: Terms
item.description:
The following terms are used in this module and come as much as possible from the official Hydro-Quebec electricity rates document (page 37):

https://www.hydroquebec.com/data/documents-donnees/pdf/electricity-rates.pdf

and from the “Régie de l’énergie” document:

http://publicsde.regie-energie.qc.ca/projets/469/DocPrj/R-4057-2018-B-0062-DDR-RepDDR-2018_10_26.pdf#page=124

Period

In the context of winter credits, a period is a time slot during which a specific rate or algorithmic logic is applied by Hydro-Québec.

item.title: Flex D Sensors
item.description:
Sensor description

The following entities are created for the DPC (Flex D) rate. Peak event entities read their data from the dedicated calendar configured in the integration; see the Flex D blueprint for automations.

Warning

Entities that represent the current state (DPC Status, Critical Peak Active, Preheat Active) depend on the calendar events and the coordinator update. For automations that must run at a precise time, prefer the timestamp entities (Next Peak Start, Next Peak End, Next Preheat Start).
